annotations.title: Get the prospectivity model's inputs at points

description: Use when the user asks for the geophysical or structural values the prospectivity model reads at specific points. For up to 25 points returns geophysics (magnetic and gravity intensity and derivatives) and structure (distances to faults and to magnetic and gravity worms, fault density); null means the point is off the layer or has no data.
name: get_model_inputs_at_points
title: Get the prospectivity model's inputs at points
